column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule configuration for ADR-0026.
# Medium-or-above passive alerts are FAIL. Lower-risk browser compatibility
# findings are INFO. IGNORE is reserved for genuinely informational findings
# with a written reason; no rules are ignored today.

column3: Health/API DAST route sets no cookies; cookie flags are evaluated when an authenticated browser route introduces cookies.
Health/API DAST route sets no cookies; cookie flags are evaluated when an authenticated browser route introduces cookies.
The API does not render password forms on the DAST target route.
Cache-control is reviewed per endpoint; authenticated data endpoints use API authorization and no shared browser cache contract is introduced by /health.
X-XSS-Protection is obsolete in modern browsers; CSP is the enforced browser control.
Cross-domain JavaScript inclusion is not applicable to the JSON health route.
Content-Type is asserted in API tests; a missing type is lower than the ADR-0026 Medium gate.
Medium anti-clickjacking finding; must be fixed by X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors.
X-Content-Type-Options is Low, but the app still sets nosniff as defense in depth.
Medium debug-error disclosure finding; verbose error pages must be fixed.
Sensitive information in URL is Medium-or-above and must be fixed.
Sensitive information in Referrer is Medium-or-above and must be fixed.
HTTP parameter override is not used by ExpenseFlow API routes.
Suspicious comments are reviewed as informational unless ZAP assigns Medium-or-above risk in the JSON gate.
Viewstate is not used by the Express API.
Medium Content-Security-Policy finding; must be fixed by an application CSP.
Mixed-content findings are Medium-or-above and must be fixed.
Informational cacheability observation only: ExpenseFlow sets no-store/no-cache on API responses, and this rule is riskcode 0 rather than a Medium-or-above security finding.
Cookie SameSite is evaluated when an authenticated browser route introduces cookies; the DAST health route sets none.
Content-Security-Policy scanner findings at Medium-or-above must be fixed.
Permissions-Policy is lower-signal for this JSON API route, but the app sets a restrictive policy.
Weak authentication findings are Medium-or-above and must be fixed.
The API uses bearer authorization and JSON mutation routes rather than cookie-backed browser forms; CSRF is reviewed when cookie auth is introduced.
Private IP disclosure is informational for the floci-only local deployment.
Session IDs in URLs are Medium-or-above and must be fixed.
Generic script passive findings are informational unless the JSON risk gate reports Medium-or-above.
JSF ViewState is not used by the Express API.
Charset mismatches are below the ADR-0026 Medium gate.
Application error disclosure is Medium-or-above and must be fixed.
Loosely scoped cookie findings are evaluated when an authenticated browser route introduces cookies; the DAST route sets none.
